$comment: In-process local TTS models for the local-tts plugin (P2-H): Kokoro v1.0 / v1.1-zh, Kitten 0.8 and Piper voices, all run by sherpa-onnx OfflineTts on the processor (runtime/sherpa-onnx, C espeak-ng). How each id runs (family, languages, voices, files) is local_tts::catalog; a unit test keeps that table and this fragment in step.

Archives are official k2-fsa "tts-models" release assets (size and sha256 = GitHub asset digests from the release listing); only the model, voices, tokens, lexicons, text-normalization FSTs, espeak-ng-data and notices are extracted (strip 1, include). The unused jieba dict/ folder of the Kokoro packages is not extracted (sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 ignores dict_dir).

Kokoro is the fp32 build: the int8 build is not faster on the processor (RTF about 1.0 at any thread count vs about 0.3 for fp32 at 4 threads on a 7800X3D, measured by P2-H) and sounds worse, so it is not listed.

The tts-models release replaces assets now and then (kokoro-multi-lang-v1_0 was re-uploaded on 2026-09-08); a replaced asset fails its hash and must be re-pinned (scripts/models/pin-catalog.mjs) together with local_tts::catalog.
Piper voice licenses differ per voice (each package carries its MODEL_CARD).

entries.description: Natural voices for English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese (54 voices), on the processor. About 350 MB download.
